rules: Every pickup/interactable item must have an evidence-bound presentation_semantics classification.
FULLSCREEN_INSPECT is permitted only when corpus/runtime/video evidence demonstrates an inspect presentation; item category or visual similarity is insufficient.
Preview art must be source-derived and bound to the exact object/material/texture identity; no invented or AI-generated substitute.
TAKE, inventory mutation, world visibility and persistence remain independent canonical state transitions.
Retail may reuse the presentation subsystem but must re-establish semantics and asset binding per retail object; demo IDs, addresses and PASS states never promote.
UNKNOWN fails closed: do not invent a fullscreen preview or interaction presentation.
